commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Work with PowerPoint (.pptx) files

commands.name: split
commands.description:
Split a .pptx file into individual single-slide files.

Examples:
  clippit pptx split deck.pptx --slides 1,3,6-9 --output slides
  clippit pptx split deck.pptx --output slides --manifest
  cat deck.pptx | clippit pptx split - --output slides --format json

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for the individual slide files (default: same directory as input, or the current directory when reading from stdin).

options.name: --slides
options.description: Slides to extract. Syntax: comma-separated list of 1-based slide numbers and/or inclusive ranges, e.g. '1,3,6-9'. Whitespace allowed around separators. Duplicates are deduplicated. Default: all slides.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing output files. Without this flag the command fails on the first collision. [default: False]

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Also write a deck manifest (clippit pptx build run compatible) alongside the slides. Path: <outputDir>/<sourceBaseName>.manifest.json (or stdin.manifest.json for stdin input). Preserves source PPTX sections when present. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the source .pptx file to split. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: build
commands.description:
Build a presentation from a manifest that assembles source .pptx files into sections.

Examples:
  clippit pptx build init --output deck.json
  clippit pptx build run deck.json --output final.pptx

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Scaffold a new empty deck manifest.

Examples:
  clippit pptx build init
  clippit pptx build init --output deck.json --force
  clippit pptx build init --output - > deck.json

options.name: --output
options.description: Path for the new manifest file (default: ./clippit-deck.json). Use '-' to write the manifest to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the manifest file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Build the final presentation from a deck manifest.

Examples:
  clippit pptx build run deck.json
  clippit pptx build run deck.json --output final.pptx --quiet
  cat deck.json | clippit pptx build run - --output - > final.pptx

options.name: --output
options.description: Override the output .pptx path from the manifest. Use '-' to write the binary to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output presentation if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: MANIFEST
arguments.description: Path to the deck manifest JSON file. Use '-' to read the manifest from stdin.

commands.name: verify
commands.description:
Validate that a .pptx file is a correct OpenXml presentation.

Examples:
  clippit pptx verify deck.pptx
  clippit pptx verify deck.pptx --format json
  clippit pptx verify deck.pptx --office-version Office2021
  cat deck.pptx | clippit pptx verify - --format json

options.name: --office-version
options.description: OpenXml schema version to validate against: Office2007, Office2010, Office2013, Office2016, Office2019, Office2021, Microsoft365 (default: Microsoft365). [default: Microsoft365]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the .pptx file to verify. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: word
commands.description: Work with Word (.docx) files

commands.name: build
commands.description:
Build a merged Word document from a manifest that combines multiple .docx sources.

Examples:
  clippit word build init --output word-build.json
  clippit word build run word-build.json --output merged.docx

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Scaffold a new empty Word build manifest.

Examples:
  clippit word build init
  clippit word build init --output word-build.json --force
  clippit word build init --output - > word-build.json

options.name: --output
options.description: Path for the new manifest file (default: ./clippit-word-build.json). Use '-' to write the manifest to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the manifest file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Build the merged Word document from a manifest.

Examples:
  clippit word build run word-build.json
  clippit word build run word-build.json --output merged.docx --quiet
  cat word-build.json | clippit word build run - --output - > merged.docx

options.name: --output
options.description: Override the output .docx path from the manifest. Use '-' to write the binary to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output document if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: MANIFEST
arguments.description: Path to the Word build manifest JSON file. Use '-' to read the manifest from stdin.

commands.name: accept-revisions
commands.description:
Accept all tracked revisions in a .docx file.

Examples:
  clippit word accept-revisions draft.docx
  clippit word accept-revisions draft.docx --output clean.docx --format json
  cat draft.docx | clippit word accept-revisions - --output clean.docx
  clippit word accept-revisions draft.docx --output - > clean.docx

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the cleaned .docx. Defaults to <input>-accepted.docx. Use '-' to write binary content to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the .docx file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: assemble
commands.description:
Assemble a .docx document from a template and XML data.

Examples:
  clippit word assemble template.docx data.xml
  clippit word assemble template.docx data.xml --output generated.docx --format json
  clippit word assemble template.docx - --output generated.docx
  clippit word assemble template.docx data.xml --output - > generated.docx

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the assembled .docx file. Defaults to the template file name with '-assembled.docx' appended. Use '-' to write binary content to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: TEMPLATE
arguments.description: Path to the template .docx file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

arguments.name: DATA
arguments.description: Path to the XML data file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: compare
commands.description:
Compare two .docx files and produce a result with tracked revisions.

Examples:
  clippit word compare before.docx after.docx
  clippit word compare before.docx after.docx --output compared.docx --format json
  clippit word compare before.docx after.docx --author "Jane Doe" --date-time 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
  cat before.docx | clippit word compare - after.docx --output compared.docx --format json

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the compared .docx file with tracked revisions. Defaults to <source>-compared.docx. Use '-' to write binary content to stdout.

options.name: --author
options.description: Author value used for generated tracked revisions.

options.name: --date-time
options.description: Date/time value used for generated tracked revisions (ISO 8601 text recommended).

options.name: --case-insensitive
options.description: Ignore case when comparing words. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: Path to the source .docx file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

arguments.name: REVISED
arguments.description: Path to the revised .docx file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: consolidate
commands.description:
Combine multiple revisions of a document into one file with tracked changes.

Examples:
  clippit word consolidate original.docx alice.docx bob.docx
  clippit word consolidate original.docx alice.docx bob.docx --output consolidated.docx --format json
  clippit word consolidate original.docx alice.docx bob.docx --revisor Alice --revisor Bob --color '#FF0000' --color '#0000FF'
  cat original.docx | clippit word consolidate - alice.docx bob.docx --output consolidated.docx

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the consolidated .docx file. Defaults to <original>-consolidated.docx. Use '-' to write binary content to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --revisor
options.description: Reviewer name for the corresponding revision file. May be repeated; defaults to the revision file name.

options.name: --color
options.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) for the corresponding revision. May be repeated; defaults to a rotating palette.

options.name: --author
options.description: Author value used for generated tracked revisions.

options.name: --date-time
options.description: Date/time value used for generated tracked revisions (ISO 8601 text recommended).

options.name: --case-insensitive
options.description: Ignore case when comparing words. [default: False]

options.name: --no-table-consolidation
options.description: Disable table-based consolidation layout. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: ORIGINAL
arguments.description: Path to the original .docx file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: simplify-markup
commands.description:
Simplify markup in a .docx file by removing non-content elements.

At least one simplification flag must be provided, or use --all.

Examples:
  clippit word simplify-markup noisy.docx --remove-rsid-info --remove-comments --output clean.docx
  clippit word simplify-markup noisy.docx --all --output clean.docx
  clippit word simplify-markup noisy.docx --all --format json

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the simplified .docx. Defaults to <input>-simplified.docx (or simplified.docx when reading from stdin). Use '-' to write binary content to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description: Enable all cleanup flags (convenience preset). [default: False]

options.name: --accept-revisions
options.description: Accept all tracked revisions before simplification. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-rsid-info
options.description: Remove RSID attributes from settings and content. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-markup-for-document-comparison
options.description: Remove document properties and markup used for comparison (implies --remove-rsid-info). [default: False]

options.name: --remove-comments
options.description: Remove comments and comment-extended markup. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-bookmarks
options.description: Remove bookmarks (including _GoBack). [default: False]

options.name: --remove-content-controls
options.description: Remove structured document tags, keeping their content. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-end-and-footnotes
options.description: Remove endnotes and footnotes. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-field-codes
options.description: Remove field codes, leaving the last cached result text. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-go-back-bookmark
options.description: Remove the _GoBack bookmark specifically. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-hyperlinks
options.description: Remove hyperlink relationships and markup. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-last-rendered-page-break
options.description: Remove lastRenderedPageBreak elements. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-permissions
options.description: Remove permission and editable-region markup. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-proof
options.description: Remove proofing errors. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-smart-tags
options.description: Remove smart-tag wrappers. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-soft-hyphens
options.description: Remove soft hyphen characters. [default: False]

options.name: --remove-web-hidden
options.description: Remove web-hidden text. [default: False]

options.name: --replace-tabs-with-spaces
options.description: Replace tab characters with spaces. [default: False]

options.name: --normalize-xml
options.description: Apply the library's XML normalization step. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the .docx file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

  clippit word verify document.docx --format json
  clippit word verify document.docx --office-version Office2021
  cat document.docx | clippit word verify - --format json

options.name: --office-version
options.description: OpenXml schema version to validate against: Office2007, Office2010, Office2013, Office2016, Office2019, Office2021, Microsoft365 (default: Microsoft365). [default: Microsoft365]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

commands.name: to-html
commands.description:
Convert a .docx file to HTML/CSS.

Examples:
  clippit word to-html document.docx
  clippit word to-html document.docx --page-title "Q3 Report" --additional-css "body { max-width: 800px; }"
  clippit word to-html document.docx --inline-images --output -
  cat document.docx | clippit word to-html - --inline-images --format json

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the generated .html file. Defaults to <input>.html. Use '-' to write HTML content to stdout.

options.name: --page-title
options.description: HTML page <title>. Defaults to the source file name.

options.name: --additional-css
options.description: Extra CSS rules injected into the generated <style> block.

options.name: --css-prefix
options.description: Prefix for auto-generated CSS class names (default: pt-). [default: pt-]

options.name: --inline-images
options.description: Embed images as base64 data URIs instead of linking to external files. [default: False]

options.name: --no-fabricate-css
options.description: Skip CSS class generation and use inline style attributes instead. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the .docx file to convert. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: from-html
commands.description:
Convert an HTML file to .docx.

Examples:
  clippit word from-html article.html
  clippit word from-html article.html -c styles.css -o article.docx
  clippit word from-html article.html --minor-font "Georgia" --font-size 11
  cat article.html | clippit word from-html - --base-uri https://example.com/images/ --format json

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the generated .docx file. Defaults to <input>.docx. Use '-' to write binary content to stdout.

options.name: --css
options.description: Path to an external author CSS file. When omitted, CSS is extracted from the HTML <style> element.

options.name: --default-css
options.description: Path to a default CSS file. When omitted, a built-in default CSS is used.

options.name: --user-css
options.description: Additional CSS rules to apply as user overrides.

options.name: --base-uri
options.description: Base URI for resolving relative image src references. Defaults to the source HTML file's parent directory.

options.name: --major-font
options.description: Theme major (heading) font name (default: Calibri Light).

options.name: --minor-font
options.description: Theme minor (body) font name (default: Times New Roman).

options.name: --font-size
options.description: Default font size in points (default: 12).

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the .html file to convert. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: excel
commands.description: Work with Excel (.xlsx) files

commands.name: verify
commands.description:
Validate that a .xlsx file is a correct OpenXml spreadsheet.

Examples:
  clippit excel verify spreadsheet.xlsx
  clippit excel verify spreadsheet.xlsx --format json
  clippit excel verify spreadsheet.xlsx --office-version Office2021
  cat spreadsheet.xlsx | clippit excel verify - --format json

options.name: --office-version
options.description: OpenXml schema version to validate against: Office2007, Office2010, Office2013, Office2016, Office2019, Office2021, Microsoft365 (default: Microsoft365). [default: Microsoft365]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the .xlsx file to verify. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: to-html
commands.description:
Convert a spreadsheet range, sheet, or table to HTML/CSS.

Examples:
  clippit excel to-html spreadsheet.xlsx -o sheet.html
  clippit excel to-html spreadsheet.xlsx --sheet "Q3 Data" --range "B2:F15"
  clippit excel to-html spreadsheet.xlsx --table "SalesTable" -o - > table.html

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the generated .html file. Defaults to <input>.html. Use '-' to write HTML content to stdout.

options.name: --sheet
options.description: The sheet name to convert. Defaults to the first sheet found if neither --range nor --table are specified.

options.name: --range
options.description: Coordinates of the cell/range to convert (e.g. A1:D10). Requires --sheet option.

options.name: --table
options.description: Name of a defined Excel table to convert. Cannot be combined with --sheet or --range.

options.name: --page-title
options.description: HTML page <title>. Defaults to the source file name.

options.name: --additional-css
options.description: Extra CSS rules injected into the generated <style> block.

options.name: --css-prefix
options.description: Prefix for auto-generated CSS class names (default: pt-). [default: pt-]

options.name: --no-fabricate-css
options.description: Skip CSS class generation and use inline style attributes instead. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the .xlsx file to convert. Use '-' to read from stdin.

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Generate an Excel (.xlsx) workbook from a JSON workbook definition.

Examples:
  clippit excel create report.json
  clippit excel create report.json --output report.xlsx --format json
  cat report.json | clippit excel create - --output report.xlsx
  clippit excel create report.json --output - > report.xlsx

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for the generated .xlsx file. Defaults to the input file name with '.xlsx' extension. Use '-' to write binary content to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json | text. Defaults to json when stdout is piped, text on a terminal. [default: Auto]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the success summary on stdout. Errors and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Path to the workbook definition JSON file. Use '-' to read from stdin.
